text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT AND BARLEY SALE - Tunisia bought four lots of barley of 25,000 tonnes each and two lots of soft wheat of 25,000 tonnes each at a tender on Tuesday, traders said. Prices for barley were $147.87 per tonne C&F for each lot at the following shipment dates -- January 20-31 1997, February 10-20, March 10-20 and April 10-20. Prices for the soft wheat were $164.33 per tonne C&F for a shipment by January 20-31 and $163.33 for February 20-28.
CORN AND SOYBEAN SALE - State-run Taiwan Sugar Corp bought 20,000 tonnes of U.S. corn and 10,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans from Continental at a tender on Tuesday, traders said.

WHEAT TENDER - The CCC said it would seek up to 30,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat under its export donation program to Bosnia. The shipment period was slated for January 25-February 20. Offers were due January 7.

WHEAT TENDER - Bangladesh has tendered for 100,000 tonnes of U.S. grade-2 or Australian Standard or better Canadian winter red/spring wheat for shipment by February 21, food ministry officials said on Sunday. The ministry would open the tender on January 18. The result of the bidding will be known within two to three days after opening of the tender.

WHEAT TENDER - Yemen has postponed until January 7 soft wheat grain and soft wheat flour tenders initially scheduled for December 26, European grain traders said on Monday. Yemen is seeking 200,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat flour for shipment between February and June and 200,000 tonnes of new crop U.S. or Canadian or Australian soft white wheat for July-September shipment, they said.
WHEAT TENDER - Sri Lanka may seek in early January 100,000 tonnes optional origin wheat for late January shipment, U.S. exporters said.
BARLEY TENDER - Iran is in the market to import 50,000 tonnes of optional-origin barley for shipment in February, European grain traders said. Iran was working on the tender it launched on Sunday.

SOYBEAN OIL TENDER - The CCC of the USDA said it will tender for 10,370 tonnes of U.S. bulk crude degummed soybean oil for donation to Peru. The delivery period was slated for February 3-18. Offers were requested by January 7. Successful offerers will be notified on January 8.
RICE TENDER - The Japanese Food Agency will hold an import tender for 7,000 tonnes of rice on December 25, agency officials said on Friday.

MARKET TALK - Saudi Arabia has imported 3.5 million tonnes of barley in the last 10 months and imports are expected to rise to four million tonnes by the end of the year, a Saudi newspaper reported on Tuesday.
... The state-run Rice Export Corp of Pakistan said on Tuesday it had received 10 bids for the sale and export of 40,000/45,000 tonnes of IRRI-6 variety rice.
